faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.copy: Upcoming customer experience ke baare mein clear answers.

launch.question: Customer experience kab launch hoga?
launch.answer: Customer experience currently prepare ho raha hai. KaunBatayega pehle verified provider network city by city build kar raha hai.

free.question: Kya KaunBatayega use karna free hoga?
free.answer: Customer access details launch se pehle announce hongi. Provider onboarding launch phase mein currently free hai.

verified.question: Professionals kaise verify hote hain?
verified.answer: Providers profile details aur documents submit karte hain. Admin team identity, service category, credentials aur profile quality review karti hai.

cities.question: Pehle kaun se cities available honge?
cities.answer: Initial city focus Mathura, Vrindavan, Agra, Delhi, Noida, Gurugram, Faridabad aur Sonipat par hai.

provider.question: Kya main aaj provider ke roop mein register kar sakta hoon?
provider.answer: Haan. Service providers account create karke verification process complete kar sakte hain.
